This is a hands-on, deeply technical architecture role. The person in this role will define how AvePoint captures identity state, protects AD and Entra configuration, restores objects and attributes, handles hybrid source-of-authority rules, and supports complex enterprise topologies such as multi-domain forests, multiple forests, trusts, and Entra Connect / Cloud Sync environments. This role is intentionally not the primary owner for AD/Entra threat detection, alert rule authoring, SIEM content, or incident response strategy. jobs.description_text: The Role: We're hiring one of the first software engineers on our electro-optical team. Today that means long-range EO/IR sensors. In future it could mean sensors on mobile and airborne platforms. Wherever the sensor sits, the job is the software that makes it, and every sensor around it, act as one system. This is a software engineering role first. You don't need to be a camera or computer vision specialist. You do need to be an excellent engineer who is curious about physical systems and understands how real sensors behave: they drift, they disagree with each other, and a field test doesn't care what the simulation said. You'll join a small, elite team that takes its own work into the field. You'll test live, change code live, and see how it holds up on the next flight. The capabilities you build will push the frontier of what these systems can do, and few engineers anywhere get to work this close to the hardware, the mission and the result. We're also changing how we build software. The aim is to take a feature or a new capability and develop as much of it as possible without real hardware, then push it up the chain: through simulation, through hardware in the loop, and on to full end-to-end tests in the real world. Simulation will keep improving, but real hardware will always have the final say. jobs.title: Data Center Power Generation and Microgrids Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the role Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. The loads involved are large enough — and arrive fast enough — that utility supply alone often can't meet the need on the timeline required, and the step-load behavior of large accelerator clusters creates power-quality and ride-through demands that conventional backup-generation designs weren't built for. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for solving that problem: delivering facilities that can be energized early, ride through grid disturbances, and present a well-behaved load at the point of interconnection (POI). As a Data Center Power Generation & Microgrids Engineer, you'll own the behind-the-meter generation and storage architecture for Anthropic's data center portfolio. That means the on-site generation fleet — reciprocating engine gensets, gas turbines, fuel cells — and the battery energy storage systems that buffer load steps and provide ride-through. It means the microgrid layer that ties them together: islanding and resynchronization, black-start, load-shedding, and generation dispatch. And it means the grid side: interconnection studies and agreements, IEEE 1547/2800 compliance, and power quality at the point of interconnection. jobs.title: Front Door Waste Technician - Allen, TX
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As the Front Door Waste Technician, you’ll manage daily waste collection and onsite disposal for a multifamily apartment community, ensuring clean, safe, and well ‑ maintained common areas and resident spaces. Waste Collection & Disposal Collect resident waste bags and place them into leak ‑ proof hampers or carts for transport. Transfer waste from carts into the designated vehicle and dispose into onsite compactors or containers. Safely operate compactors as needed and clear debris or obstructions from the area. Remove trash from dog waste stations, pool areas, mail kiosks, and other common spaces. Walk property routes (including stairs) to provide valet trash services. Site Cleanliness & Safety Monitor for improper or prohibited waste; take appropriate action when identified. Clean spills, surrounding doorsteps, sidewalks, parking lots, and compactor areas. Follow all department productivity requirements to complete routes efficiently. Adhere to EPA, OSHA, and all company safety policies and procedures. Customer Service & Reporting Interact with residents, staff, and management professionally and courteously each day. Log start/end times and complete required reporting through a mobile app, including photos. Maintain a high level of visibility and consistent communication while onsite. Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent (preferred) At least one year of experience in waste services or a customer‑service‑focused role Knowledge of EPA and OSHA regul
